name: SRE · Traefik certificate expires within 30 days
titleTemplate: SRE · Traefik certificate expires within 30 days · ${cluster_name} · ${namespace} · ${sans} · ${serial}
description: Checks Traefik certificate expires within 30 days. Values are evaluated every 60 seconds. Windows apply to observed samples; inspect collection health before interpreting a missing result. Thresholds are starting points to review against the workload baseline.
remediation:
1. Read the certificate SANs and serial number in the title. The observed value is days remaining; a negative value means expired.
2. Check the issuing controller, Ingress Secret and renewal errors.
3. Confirm the renewed certificate is actually served by every Traefik replica.

name: SRE · Ingress inventory collection failing · 3m
description: Checks Ingress inventory collection failing · 3m. Values are evaluated every 60 seconds. Windows apply to observed samples; inspect collection health before interpreting a missing result. Thresholds are starting points to review against the workload baseline.
remediation:
1. Check the collector pod, readiness, recent and previous logs.
2. Verify DNS, TLS, NetworkPolicy, endpoint reachability, ingestion credentials and remote-write responses.
3. Check queue growth and dropped samples. A running pod does not prove successful delivery.

name: SRE · Traefik metrics scrape failing · 3m
description: A configured Traefik endpoint has no successful scrape in the observed three-minute window. A missing target is different from a failed scrape; validate the inventory as well.
remediation:
1. Check the collector pod, readiness, recent and previous logs.
2. Verify DNS, TLS, NetworkPolicy, endpoint reachability, ingestion credentials and remote-write responses.
3. Check queue growth and dropped samples. A running pod does not prove successful delivery.

name: SRE · Traefik HTTP 5xx above 5 percent · 5m
query: min_over_time(((((sum by(cluster_name,service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{protocol="http",code=~"5.."}[5m]))) or on(cluster_name,service) (0 * (sum by(cluster_name,service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{protocol="http"}[5m])))))/(sum by(cluster_name,service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{protocol="http"}[5m])) >= 100)) * on(cluster_name,service) group_left(namespace,backend) (max by(cluster_name,namespace,service,backend) (label_replace(sre_ingress_backend_info{ingress_namespace!=""}, "namespace", "$1", "ingress_namespace", "(.*)"))))[5m:30s])
description: More than 5% of completed requests fail with HTTP 5xx, with at least 100 requests in each observed five-minute calculation window. The condition must persist over observed samples for five minutes. Uses Traefik counters, not span sampling.
remediation: Open the HTTP 5xx timeline and identify application, code and time. Correlate Traefik access logs and application traces/logs. Check readiness, dependencies and recent deployments. Do not treat expected 4xx responses as server failures.

name: SRE · Traefik p95 response above 3s · 10m
query: min_over_time((((histogram_quantile(0.95,sum by(cluster_name,service,le) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{protocol="http"}[5m])))) and on(cluster_name,service) (sum by(cluster_name,service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{protocol="http"}[5m])) >= 100)) * on(cluster_name,service) group_left(namespace,backend) (max by(cluster_name,namespace,service,backend) (label_replace(sre_ingress_backend_info{ingress_namespace!=""}, "namespace", "$1", "ingress_namespace", "(.*)"))))[10m:30s])
description: The estimated 95th-percentile response time exceeds 3 seconds. This means the boundary below which about 95% of requests finish is above 3 seconds; it does not mean 95% of requests take longer than 3 seconds. Requires at least 100 requests per five-minute calculation window, persisting over observed samples for ten minutes. Replace this starting threshold with the service objective.
remediation: Compare slow and successful/error requests, backend latency, host/Pod saturation and dependencies. Exclude or separately baseline streaming and long-polling APIs when required. Compare the same time interval.
